text: If you would particularly gain the affection and friendship of particular people, whether men or women, endeavor to find out the predominant excellency, if they have one, and their prevailing weakness, which everybody has; and do justice to the one, and something more than justice to the other.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter XVII, to his son, London, October 16, Old Style 1747
